description: Per-sensor calibration keyed by sensor_id (the dome map's positions name the sensor mounted there), in the sensor's own axes: deg_per_mv maps (drag, lift) mV after tare and the position's polarity -> (drag, lift) deg (drag + = tip toward the front, lift + = tip up), as [[a, b], [c, d]] or [g_drag, g_lift]; optional date, source, note. Sensors with no entry use the placeholder gain. Example entry: "S07": {"deg_per_mv": [1.0, 1.0], "date": "2026-11-02", "source": "gantry sweep run 12"}
